content.title: About
content.content: The sweet fruit roll is a diet-friendly dessert covered with a light frosting. The dough is made from whole‑grain flour, a modest amount of sugar and fat substitutes, while the filling consists of fresh berries and fruit sweetened with stevia. The frosting adds a gentle shine without extra calories.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Diet rolls often use sugar substitutes such as stevia or erythritol to lower calorie content.
The fruit filling provides natural sweetness and adds vitamins C and A.
Frosting can be made from plant oil and a small amount of cocoa powder, making it lighter.
These rolls are traditionally served in small portions, ideal for calorie control.
Some recipes incorporate protein powder into the dough for added nutrition.

items.title: Low Calorie
items.content: A diet roll contains far fewer calories than regular sweet pastries thanks to sugar substitutes and whole‑grain flour.

items.title: Rich in Vitamins
items.content: The fruit filling supplies vitamin C, vitamin A, and antioxidants that help protect cells.

items.title: Supports Digestion
items.content: Whole‑grain flour and fruit fiber promote healthy bowel function.

items.title: Lower Glycemic Impact
items.content: Using sugar substitutes and whole grains helps avoid sharp blood‑sugar spikes.

items.title: Source of Plant Protein
items.content: Some versions add protein powder, increasing the protein content.

items.title: Allergy to Ingredients
items.content: The roll may contain nuts, dairy, or gluten, which should be considered by people with allergies.

items.title: Sensitivity to Sugar Substitutes
items.content: Erythritol or stevia can cause mild digestive upset in some individuals.

items.title: Natural Fruit Sugar
items.content: Although natural, the fruit sugar should be accounted for by those monitoring glucose levels.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the roll as a standalone snack, slice it into bite‑size pieces, and serve with a berry sauce or low‑fat yogurt. Its compact size makes it convenient for on‑the‑go consumption.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the roll in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2‑3 days. For longer storage (up to 1 week) refrigerate. Before eating, check that the frosting shows no signs of mold.
